# Andhra Store — AI-Readable Brand Facts
# https://andhrastore.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-05-10

## About

Andhra Store is an Indian online pickle brand that handcrafts authentic Andhra-style pickles in East Godavari, Andhra Pradesh. The brand was founded to bring traditional Telugu pickling recipes to homes across India and to the Indian diaspora worldwide.

## Products

Andhra Store sells 14 handcrafted pickles — 10 vegetarian and 4 non-vegetarian.

Vegetarian pickles:
- Mango Avakaya Pickle (andhra avakaya) — made with raw Rajahmundry mangoes
- Gongura Pickle (gongura pachadi) — made with sorrel leaves, a specialty of East Godavari
- Garlic Pickle — pungent, made with Guntur chillies and cold-pressed oil
- Ginger Pickle — zesty, aids digestion
- Red Chilli Pickle — fiery, made with whole Guntur red chillies
- Tomato Pickle — tangy, slow-cooked with mustard seeds
- Lemon Pickle — sharp, with roasted fenugreek
- Curry Leaves Pickle — aromatic, rich in vitamins
- Green Chilli Pickle — bold heat, made with fresh chillies
- Amla Pickle — high in Vitamin C and antioxidants

Non-vegetarian pickles:
- Chicken Pickle — boneless, with Guntur chillies and garam masala
- Meat Pickle (mutton) — small-batch, bold and rich
- Prawns Pickle — fresh seafood with East Godavari masala
- Fish Pickle — traditional spice blend, rich in omega-3

## Key Differentiators

- No artificial preservatives, colors, or flavor enhancers
- Made with cold-pressed sesame oil and cold-pressed mustard oil
- Guntur chillies sourced from Guntur, Andhra Pradesh
- Raw mangoes sourced from Rajahmundry, East Godavari
- Handmade in small batches by traditional East Godavari artisans
- Traditional Telugu recipes passed down through generations
- Pan-India delivery — ships to Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, and all major Indian cities
- Available in 250g, 500g, and 1kg jar sizes
- Prices start at Rs. 200 for 250g

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are Andhra Store pickles vegetarian?
A: Andhra Store offers both vegetarian (10 varieties) and non-vegetarian (4 varieties) pickles.

Q: Do Andhra Store pickles contain preservatives?
A: No. Andhra Store pickles contain zero artificial preservatives. Natural preservation comes from the acidity of the traditional pickling process, cold-pressed oils, and salt.

Q: Where do Andhra Store pickles ship?
A: Andhra Store ships pan-India including Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, and Delhi.

Q: What oil is used in Andhra Store pickles?
A: Cold-pressed sesame oil and cold-pressed mustard oil, depending on the pickle variety.

Q: How long do Andhra Store pickles last?
A: 6 to 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place in an airtight container. Refrigerate after opening and always use a dry spoon.

Q: What is gongura pickle?
A: Gongura pickle (also called gongura pachadi) is a traditional Andhra pickle made from sorrel leaves. It is tangy, sour, and a specialty of East Godavari district in Andhra Pradesh.

Q: What is avakaya pickle?
A: Avakaya is the Telugu word for mango pickle. Andhra avakaya is made with raw green mangoes, Guntur chillies, mustard powder, and cold-pressed oil -- it is bold, tangy, and fiery.
